verdict.rationale: The evidence points to GitHub's own building blocks for merge governance: a community report lists protected branches and code owners as paid-plan features for private repos (github-comm-16), and GitHub Actions runs custom CI/CD workflows in the repository (github-docs-11, github-docs-38). First-party docs also describe pull requests being reviewed for quality and security before merge (github-docs-61). However, no evidence explicitly documents that custom checks can be made required to block merges. missing for 10: first-party docs on required status checks or rulesets that block merges, documented custom compliance check configuration, org-wide enforcement policy, independent hands-on corroboration.
